content.value: A counter flow heat exchanger of heat transfer area $1 3 ~ \mathrm m ^ { 2 }$ is to cool oil $( C _ { \mathrm { p } } { = } 2 0 0 0$ J/kg.sec) with water. The oil enters at $1 0 6 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ with mass flow rate of 2.0 kg/sec, while the water enters at $2 2 ^ { \circ } C$ with a mass flow rate of 0.65 kg/sec. The overall heat transfer coefficient is $U = 4 0 0 \mathrm { W / m } ^ { 2 \circ } \mathrm { C }$ . Calculate the exit temperature of water and the total heat transfer rate.
